repairs.quote: Diana creates three orbiting spheres for 5 seconds that explode on contact, each dealing (20/32/44/56/68 + (18% Ability Power)) magic damage, up to a max of (60/96/132/168/204 + (54% Ability Power)) damage. Diana also gains (45/60/75/90/105 + (30% Ability Power) + (11% bonus Health)) Shield for the same duration. When the last sphere detonates, she gains an additional (45/60/75/90/105 + (30% Ability Power) + (11% bonus Health)) Shield and refreshes the duration.
